market_research_agent.name: Market Research Agent
market_research_agent.description: Searches web for real-time competitor activities, product launches, pricing changes, and market movements using Perplexity's web search capabilities

benchmarking_agent.name: Benchmarking Agent
benchmarking_agent.description: Analyzes user-provided product metrics against competitor data to identify performance gaps and strategic opportunities

trend_analysis_agent.name: Trend Analysis Agent
trend_analysis_agent.description: Identifies emerging market patterns, industry shifts, and strategic implications from collected competitive data

manager_agent.name: Competitive Intelligence Manager
manager_agent.description: Coordinates sub-agents to collect market data, benchmark metrics, identify trends, and synthesize comprehensive competitive analysis reports

distribution_agent.name: Report Distribution Agent
distribution_agent.description: Sends finalized competitive analysis reports via Gmail and posts summaries to designated Slack channels
